title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover the best social and cultural activities at Brown University that require no admission or purchase, from historic observatory viewings to student-led art tours.

cards.title: Public Viewing Nights
cards.subtitle: Stargazing at the historic 1891 observatory
cards.notes: Visit on Tuesday nights for free telescope viewings of planets and stars. Check the official site for weather updates and seasonal hours before heading up the hill.
cards.short_summary: Free weekly public stargazing sessions using a historic 12-inch refractor telescope.
cards.evidence_claim: Ladd Observatory holds scheduled Public Nights on Tuesday evenings with no admission fee, though free tickets may be required.
cards.source_title: Ladd Observatory | Department of Physics | Brown University
cards.access_notes: Open to the public on Tuesday evenings; check the website for specific start times which vary by season.

cards.title: Contemporary Art Exhibits
cards.subtitle: Modern works in the Philip Johnson-designed List Art Building
cards.notes: Explore rotating exhibitions of contemporary art and works from the permanent collection. The gallery is located on the first floor and is always free to enter.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary art space hosting major exhibitions and public events throughout the year.
cards.evidence_claim: The David Winton Bell Gallery is free and open to the public, featuring contemporary art exhibitions and a collection of over 7,000 works.
cards.access_notes: Open daily 11 AM–5 PM during exhibitions; extended hours until 8 PM on Thursdays and Fridays.

cards.title: Special Collection Exhibits
cards.subtitle: Rare books and archives in the Willis Reading Room
cards.notes: Sign in at the front desk to view curated displays of rare manuscripts and artifacts. The historic reading room offers a quiet, grand atmosphere for study.
cards.short_summary: Publicly accessible exhibitions featuring rare items from Brown's special collections and archives.
cards.evidence_claim: Visitors without Brown IDs may visit the John Hay Library to view exhibits and special collections materials during public access hours.
cards.source_title: John Hay Library Home Page - Brown University Library
cards.access_notes: Public access hours are typically weekdays 10 AM–5 PM; visitors must sign in at the entrance.

cards.title: Student-Led Art Tours
cards.subtitle: Guided walks through campus sculptures
cards.notes: Join a 40-minute weekend tour to learn the history behind campus landmarks like the Bronze Bruno. Tours meet at the bear statue on the College Green.
cards.short_summary: Free, student-curated walking tours exploring Brown's extensive outdoor public art collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brown Arts Institute offers free, student-led public art tours every Saturday and Sunday from April through November.
cards.source_title: Public Art Tours | Brown Arts Institute
cards.access_notes: Tours run Saturdays and Sundays at 1 PM; no advance registration is required for these outdoor walks.

cards.title: A Cappella Arch Sings
cards.subtitle: Live vocal performances under the archway
cards.notes: Catch one of Brown's many a cappella groups performing in this acoustic hotspot. These informal concerts are frequent on weekend evenings and always free.
cards.short_summary: Informal, free vocal performances by student a cappella groups utilizing the arch's natural acoustics.
cards.evidence_claim: Student a cappella groups like The Higher Keys and Brown Derbies frequently perform free 'arch sings' under Wayland Arch.
cards.access_notes: Performances are typically unscheduled or announced via student social media; most common on Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.title: Granoff Center Exhibitions
cards.subtitle: Interdisciplinary art in the Granoff Center
cards.notes: Visit the first-floor gallery for multimedia installations and student-curated shows. The building itself is a modern architectural landmark on Angell Street.
cards.short_summary: A gallery space within the Granoff Center showcasing thematic and research-based art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cohen Gallery in the Granoff Center is free and open to the public, featuring rotating thematic exhibitions.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday 9 AM–10 PM, with weekend hours from 12 PM to 6 PM or 8 PM.

cards.title: Main Green Socializing
cards.subtitle: The central hub of campus life
cards.notes: Join students for frisbee, spikeball, or picnicking on the grass. It is the primary spot for people-watching and outdoor relaxation between classes.
cards.short_summary: The iconic central lawn of Brown University used for recreation, study, and major student events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Main Green is a public campus space where students and visitors can lounge, picnic, and play lawn games for free.
cards.source_title: 10 things to do while you're on College Hill - The Brown Daily Herald
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for public use; subject to university green space policies for organized events.

cards.title: Entrepreneurship Workshops
cards.subtitle: Free talks and pitch events
cards.notes: Attend open workshops and guest speaker sessions to learn about startups. Most events are free and provide a great way to network with the local community.
cards.short_summary: A hub for student innovation offering free workshops, talks, and networking events open to the community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nelson Center hosts various free events, including the B-Lab Expo and guest speaker talks, which are often open to the public.
cards.source_title: Events - Nelson Center for Entrepreneurship - Brown University
cards.access_notes: Events are held throughout the academic year; check the online calendar for specific public-facing sessions.

cards.title: Free Group Fitness
cards.subtitle: Student-only workout sessions
cards.notes: Brown students can join yoga, pilates, and spin classes at no extra cost. Bring your student ID to the Nelson Fitness Center to participate.
cards.short_summary: Complimentary group fitness classes offered to all active Brown University students.
cards.evidence_claim: Brown students receive free access to group fitness classes at the Nelson Fitness Center as part of their student benefits.
cards.source_title: I Tried Five of Brown U's Free Workout Classes
cards.access_notes: Restricted to Brown and RISD ID holders; classes require registration via the BFit app.

cards.title: Student Art Galleries
cards.subtitle: Exhibitions by Visual Art concentrators
cards.notes: Walk through the upper floors of the List Art Building to see student capstone projects and juried shows. These galleries highlight emerging campus talent.
cards.short_summary: Exhibition spaces dedicated to showcasing the work of Brown University visual art students.
cards.evidence_claim: The List Art Building houses exhibition spaces primarily dedicated to the display of student work, which are free to visit.
cards.source_title: Our Spaces - Visual Art | Brown University
cards.access_notes: Open 8:30 AM–5:00 PM during the academic year; visitors should check in at the main office if visiting upper floors.
